name: ChatGPT Wallet
desc: A stored card your agent can pay with, approved each time.
desc_zh: 一张由你存放的卡，Agent 代付时每一笔都要你当面批准。
solves: An agent that cannot pay stops at the checkout page. Wallet hands over a substitute credential instead of your real card, and you approve the merchant, items and total first.
solves_zh: 不会付款的 Agent 到结账页就卡住。Wallet 交出的是替代凭据而不是真实卡号，而且商家、商品和金额都要你先过目再批准。
best_for: You asked your dot to book or buy something and expect to confirm it on your phone.
best_for_zh: 你让 dot 去订或去买东西，并准备在手机上确认这一笔。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-wallet/）。 Reached through dots, not as a standalone app. At launch limited to ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ in the US with an eligible US-issued card. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-wallet/
